title: Recombinant Human Lysozyme Attenuates Hyperosmolarity-Induced Dry Eye Disease by Suppressing Oxidative Stress and Modulating NLRP3 Inflammasome Signaling.
snippet: Given the escalating global prevalence of dry eye disease (DED) and the inadequacy of current palliative management, this study was to evaluate thetherapeutic potential of recombinant lysozyme (rlysozyme) and investigate underlying mechanisms. Human corneal epithelial cells (HCEC) were subjected to hyperosmotic stress and treated with graded rlysozyme. Cell...
